prompt: Which is larger: a toaster or a microwave?
response:
The size of a toaster versus a microwave can vary, but generally, a microwave is larger than a toaster. 

A typical toaster is usually around 15-20 inches (38-51 cm) in length, 8-10 inches (20-25 cm) in width, and 4-6 inches (10-15 cm) in height. 

A standard microwave, on the other hand, is usually around 18-24 inches (46-61 cm) in width, 12-15 inches (30-38 cm) in depth, and 12-15 inches (30-38 cm) in height. 

So, while there can be some variation depending on the specific models, a microwave is generally larger than a toaster.
